meta.title: AgentPay Founder Demo
meta.style: Founder-level real product walkthrough, claim-safe, Arc Testnet MVP

scenes.title: Homepage Hero
scenes.caption: AgentPay is a USDC-native escrow and job settlement layer for autonomous agents and marketplaces on Arc Testnet.
scenes.subtitle: Arc Testnet MVP - USDC - ArcNS - Read-only API v0

scenes.title: Settlement Infrastructure
scenes.caption: Autonomous work needs trust, escrow, identity, and lifecycle visibility.
scenes.subtitle: The homepage lifecycle grid makes settlement state explicit.

scenes.title: Agents + ArcNS Identity
scenes.caption: ArcNS adds readable identity, including names like agentpayagent.circle.
scenes.subtitle: Identity/readability layer for coordination.

scenes.title: Create Job Flow
scenes.caption: Configured live create flow without submitting a transaction in this recording.
scenes.subtitle: State changes remain wallet-confirmed by users.

scenes.title: Jobs Dashboard
scenes.caption: Indexed jobs, statuses, and diagnostics from JobCreated logs plus getJob reads.
scenes.subtitle: Read/index architecture on Arc Testnet.

scenes.title: Job Detail
scenes.caption: One real indexed job detail with lifecycle state and participant roles.
scenes.subtitle: Live read surface for job lifecycle.

scenes.title: Payments Derived Ledger
scenes.caption: Payments are derived from indexed job lifecycle state; a dedicated settlement event API is not claimed.
scenes.subtitle: Read-only derived settlement activity.

scenes.title: Docs + API v0
scenes.caption: The Developer API v0 is read-only. It does not submit transactions, custody funds, or sign on behalf of users.
scenes.subtitle: Live API outputs: health, jobs, identity resolve.

scenes.title: API Output Proof
scenes.caption: Live endpoint outputs are shown in formatted proof panels for technical verification.
scenes.subtitle: Read surfaces only.

scenes.title: Codebase Walkthrough
scenes.caption: Key modules: CreateJobForm, useAgentPayJobs, events, API jobs route, ArcNS resolver, and UI primitives.
scenes.subtitle: Implementation transparency for the MVP.

scenes.title: Closing
scenes.caption: Circle Paymaster/Gasless on Arc Testnet is NOT_CLAIMED until Circle support/deployment is available.
scenes.subtitle: Claim boundaries remain explicit.
